notes: The editor's gloss «هو ابن عباد» is left out; «عباد» is the link at its first occurrence
K6I lists نصر بن عمران between عباد and Ibn Abbas, but the text writes only «عن أبي جمرة»; the text is followed, no identity decided
Ibn Abbas is the last link: «فقال» gives the Prophet's words through him
